title: Contract is silent on several request edge cases the backend now fixes implicitly (mux redirects, duplicate keys, underflow, Content-Type leniency)
evidence: Verified 2026-10-13. (1) Coordinator smoke on :8080: GET /api -> 307 Temporary Redirect, Location: /api/, text/html body; GET /api/ -> 404 problem+json NOT_FOUND. openapi.yaml line 45 only defines 404 NOT_FOUND for 'No route under /api/'. Reviewer probes (httptest, run by the review worker): POST //api/v1/calculations, /api/v1/./calculations and /api/x/../v1/calculations -> 307 with empty body (net/http ServeMux path cleaning). (2) Reviewer probes: duplicate keys, last wins ({"operation":"add","operation":"subtract","operands":[5,3]} -> 200 subtract = 2); operand 1e-400 underflows to 0, so divide [1,1e-400] -> 422 DIVISION_BY_ZERO; Content-Type 'application/json;', 'charset="utf-8"', a trailing tab and a repeated identical charset are accepted by mime.ParseMediaType.
impact: Low: none of these affect valid calculations or the frontend; clients hitting them get a redirect or a lenient interpretation the contract does not document.
precautions: Decide in a contract branch (docs/api is read-only for backend/frontend branches): document the current behavior or tighten it with examples; then align httpapi (e.g. an exact '/api' route) in a backend branch.

snapshot.title: Contract is silent about /api without a trailing slash (Go mux answers 307 HTML redirect)
snapshot.evidence: Verified on 2026-10-13 against the built server on :8080: GET /api -> 307 Temporary Redirect, Location: /api/, Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8, body 'Temporary Redirect.'; GET /api/ -> 404 application/problem+json NOT_FOUND. openapi.yaml line 45 only defines 404 NOT_FOUND for 'No route under /api/'. The redirect comes from net/http ServeMux subtree handling of the '/api/' pattern in backend/internal/httpapi/routes.go.
snapshot.impact: Low: a client calling /api gets an HTML redirect instead of a problem document; no calculation path is affected and the frontend never calls /api.
snapshot.precautions: Decide in a contract branch (docs/api is read-only for backend/frontend branches): either document that /api redirects to /api/, or require a 404 problem for /api and add an example; then register an exact '/api' route in httpapi.
